page.overview:
Who is Beetle Mania Toad?

The Beetle Mania Toad is a Toad with blue spots on his head.

The Beetle Mania Toad can be first found in the Inn of the Mushroom Kingdom playing games on his Game Boy. If Mario tries to talk to him, the Beetle Mania Toad will yell at him to leave. However, once Mario completes Marrymore after dealing with Booster, the Beetle Mania Toad will sell him the Game Boy for 500 coins. Mario can now play the Beetle Mania minigame. Talking with the Beetle Mania Toad again will allow him to give instructions on how to play Beetle Mania.
